
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/developer-tianyiyun/p/19308903" title="发布于 2025-12-04 19:08">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">nginx解决进程内存占用翻倍</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本文分享自天翼云开发者社区《<a href="https://www.ctyun.cn/developer/article/444952717525061" rel="noopener nofollow">nginx解决进程内存占用翻倍</a>》.作者：z****n</p>
<h1>1.问题</h1>
<p>某天，线上生成环境发现一个问题：</p>
<p>某一台机器线上的nginx进程占用的内存是其他机器的2倍 ，尝试对nginx进行reload后，并没有恢复</p>
<p>内存占用翻倍机器：</p>
<p><img data-src="https://ctyun-developers-0510.gdoss.xstore.ctyun.cn/prod/a3cee08ec2ed411da6987bec271ab501.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>正常机器：</p>
<p><img data-src="https://ctyun-developers-0510.gdoss.xstore.ctyun.cn/prod/b5a14160629a4cee8f97aec8bfaa6d2a.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1>2.分析</h1>
<p>1.每次reload或者启动时worker进程从master进程fork出来，所以reload后worker进程的内存和master进程内存大小应该保持一致。</p>
<p>2.由于master进程reload时，是先用一个全新的结构体解析配置后，再free释放到原有配置的结构体。所以master进程再reload过程，会短暂的保持2个结构体（内存2倍），再变为1个全新配置结构体（内存正常）。所以猜测2倍的原因和这个原理有关，很可能是内存泄漏，没有释放原有结构体。</p>
<p>3.内存占用2倍的机器上对nginx进行不断的reload，发现内存保持不变，依然保持2倍。所以推翻第2步的猜测，若是nginx内存泄漏，那每次reload都会造成内存不断增长，而不是一直保持2倍状态</p>
<p>4.由于nginx中使用的是glibc的malloc/free， 即在程序中调用malloc 函数开辟一段空间后，再次调用free函数，程序会把开启的空间还给glibc，但是glibc不一定会把内存还给操作系统。除非调用<em>malloc_trim</em>(0)。所以怀疑大概率要加上一个<em>malloc_trim</em>(0)</p>
<h1>3.复现</h1>
<h2>1.准备</h2>
<p>在本地机器上准备一个简单的nginx，nginx中包含众多的server{} 配置（server数量多时候比较好复现）</p>
<p>nginx.conf 配置如下</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">worker_processes  <span class="token number">1<span class="token punctuation">;
error_log  logs/error.log  debug<span class="token punctuation">;
events <span class="token punctuation">{
    worker_connections  <span class="token number">1024<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}

http <span class="token punctuation">{
    include       mime.types<span class="token punctuation">;
    default_type  application/octet-stream<span class="token punctuation">;
    server_names_hash_max_size <span class="token number">8192<span class="token punctuation">;
    server_names_hash_bucket_size <span class="token number">256<span class="token punctuation">;
    server <span class="token punctuation">{
        listen <span class="token number">80<span class="token punctuation">;
        location / <span class="token punctuation">{
            root html<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token punctuation">}
    <span class="token punctuation">}
    include server/*.conf<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>server 目录如下中是一堆server{}块，如下</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash">server <span class="token punctuation">{
        listen <span class="token number">80<span class="token punctuation">;
        server_name www.a.com1<span class="token punctuation">;
        location / <span class="token punctuation">{
                <span class="token builtin class-name">return <span class="token number">200 okokokokok<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token punctuation">}
 <span class="token punctuation">}
server <span class="token punctuation">{
        listen <span class="token number">80<span class="token punctuation">;
        server_name www.a.com2<span class="token punctuation">;
        location / <span class="token punctuation">{
                <span class="token builtin class-name">return <span class="token number">200 okokokokok<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token punctuation">}
 <span class="token punctuation">}
<span class="token comment">####大量不同server_name 的server{}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h2>2.测试</h2>
<p>启动nginx，观察当前内存</p>
<p><img data-src="https://ctyun-developers-0510.gdoss.xstore.ctyun.cn/prod/0d34998881e1407c94eb7c8d6d35fe81.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>进行reload 操作，观察当前内存，发现内存翻了一倍</p>
<p><img data-src="https://ctyun-developers-0510.gdoss.xstore.ctyun.cn/prod/a5b57c653acd46b9a41b47faab772f41.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1>4.解决</h1>
<p>在 src/os/unix/ngx_process_cycle.c 中 解析完新配置释放旧的配置的结构体后，增加一行 malloc_trim(0)后，重新编译。再次启动nginx， reload后，观察内存不会翻倍</p>
<p><img data-src="https://ctyun-developers-0510.gdoss.xstore.ctyun.cn/prod/da553f499618410396909b57d115b8f8.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>有的nginx中使用了jemalloc中替换了glibc也可能遇到这个问题，需要把malloc_trim函数 替换为mallctl函数，同时加上3个jemalloc的头文件，差别如下</p>
<pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token number">12,15d11
<span class="token operator">&lt; <span class="token comment">#include &lt;jemalloc/jemalloc.h&gt;
<span class="token operator">&lt; <span class="token comment">#include &lt;jemalloc/internal/jemalloc_internal_defs.h&gt;
<span class="token operator">&lt; <span class="token comment">#include &lt;jemalloc/internal/util.h&gt;
<span class="token operator">&lt; 
235c231
<span class="token operator">&lt; 	    mallctl<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">"arena." STRINGIFY<span class="token punctuation">(MALLCTL_ARENAS_ALL<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token string">".purge", NULL, NULL, NULL, <span class="token number">0<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
---
<span class="token operator">&gt; 	    malloc_trim<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token number">0<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
